rule_description: Powershell was used to delete files or directories
command_line: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object WindowsProductName,WindowsVersion,OsBuildNumber,CsName; Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object Manufacturer,Model,TotalPhysicalMemory; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption,Version,BuildNumber,OSArchitecture; Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors; Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystem,Size,SizeRemaining; Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq 'Running'} | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Status"
